answer: Because the derivation is bound to the gale signature, the pearl gate rejects a mismatch, and the vertex checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. A bank of pre-written answers thus has nothing to key against, and filling 97 aliases means authoring 97 texts that each match their own nonce. Each challenge carries a 63 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
